decisions.summary: the pulled lane's clearance row re-tiered E2 and fixed: straighten_joints passes the threshing yards and gardens to _one_joint, whose pull also needs _clear_touch at 7 ft against them; everything else keeps the touch at max(4, w/2+2)
decisions.why: Round 1's item was that 0081 licenses the touch for BUILDINGS only ('keep its usual clearance from fences and buildings. It may come right up to the buildings'); the fix takes two kinds OUT of the touch rather than limiting it TO buildings. _clear_touch(p[a], p[b], hard, walls, water, g) still applies g (4-4.5 ft) to hard = hard_built (the crop, marsh and wet toe, whose usual clearance is 0081's own 8 ft WEB_HARD_GAP) and to walls = the whole fabric (per-house groves, wells, the wood seat, commons and village groves, non-building fixtures). The fix is right for fences; the rest of the exception's reach is still unlicensed, and the claim line now reads 'where a straightened lane touches a BUILDING' and tasks.md says the touch 'is the buildings' alone' - both false of the code (round 1's grounds: the claim does not say what the code does). Remedy: the touch at g against the buildings only (houses, sheds, byres, retirement houses, and whichever fixtures the session records as buildings), every other obstacle at _clear_link's usual margins (8 ft hard, 7 ft fabric); or FR-004's exception path with a measurement if that cannot be done.
